title: DIY-Thermocam BOM Row
description: Canonical schema for a single row in hardware/bom/bom.csv, shared by KiCad, CI validation, and the documentation website.

hw_rev.description: Target hardware revision: all (shared), v3.0 (1:1 Eagle/KiCad port), or v3.1 (USB-C + BQ24075 PCBA revision).

category.description: Functional grouping used for website tables and cost breakdowns.

designators.description: Comma-separated PCB reference designators (e.g. R1,R3,R4,R6), or empty for off-board items.

qty.description: Quantity required per camera unit (or pack count when unit_price_usd is a pack price, noted in notes).

value_spec.description: Electrical or mechanical specification (resistance, voltage, thread, capacity, config).

package.description: Physical footprint, case code, or standard (e.g. 0603, VQFN-16, Axial-0.4, Module, ISO-M2.5).

mpn.description: Manufacturer Part Number or ISO/DIN standard designation.

lcsc_part.description: LCSC/JLCPCB C-number (e.g. C15464) when sourced for PCBA, otherwise empty.

seeed_opl_part.description: Seeed Studio Fusion OPL SKU when pinned, or empty (Seeed Shenzhen OPL matches MPN/LCSC automatically).

pcba_tier.description: Assembly classification: JLCPCB/Seeed basic SMD, extended SMD/THT, manual THT soldering, off-board module/mechanical, or optional.

primary_url.description: Verified HTTPS product URL for primary_supplier.

alt_url.description: Optional verified HTTPS product URL for alt_supplier.

unit_price_usd.description: Estimated single-unit price in USD (2026 reference).

status.description: Lifecycle status: active, optional (excluded from required totals), workaround (e.g. V3.0 TP4056), or eol_notice.

notes.description: Assembly, polarity, configuration, or sourcing notes.
